CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE E.S.INDIRESH
ORAL JUDGMENT
1. Heard the learned counsels for the parties.

2. These appeals are arising out of the Judgment and award dated 05.09.2019 passed in MVC No.488/2017, MVC No.489/2017 and MVC No.487/2017 on the file of the II Additional Senior Civil Judge and MACT, Kalaburagi (for short 'the Tribunal'), awarding compensation to the claimants.

entities.text: II Additional Senior Civil Judge and
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 3. For the sake of convenience, the parties will be referred to as per their ranking before the Tribunal.
NC: 2026:KHC-K:959 HC-KAR 4.

It is the case of the claimants that, on 21.12.2016 the claimants were travelling in car bearing registration No.KA- 32/N-4640 and at that time, the driver of the car drove the same in a rash and negligent manner and dashed to a hill in a curve, as a result of the same, the claimants sustained grievous injuries.
Hence, the claim petitions were filed before the Tribunal.
The said claim petition was contested by the respondents.
5. The tribunal after considering the material on record has partly awarded the claim petition and awarded compensation.

Sharanabasappa S/O Shamrao vs Jayashree W/O Basawaraj Ratkal And Anr on 4 February, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/102802518/
4
6. Having taken note of the submission made by the learned counsel appearing for the parties, the claimants are not entitled for loss of future earning as the claimants were the government servants.

In that view of the matter, looking into the wound certificate produced by the claimants and also taking into the evidence of P.W.4, I am of the view that the claimants in all these cases are entitled for a sum of Rs.80,000/- each along with interest at the rate of 6% per annum from the date NC:
2026:KHC-K:959 HC-KAR of petition till realization, in addition to the award made by the Tribunal.
(iii) The respondent No.2-Insurance company is directed to deposit the compensation along with interest within a period of six weeks from the date of this order.

Sd/-
